comment: The canyon steppe's and the stone desert's ground (doc/BIOME_PLAN.md 3.3), painted into <world>_biomes.png by tools/terrain_lab/steppe_ground.py on the biome map's grid. `rel` is where a cell stands between the lowest (0) and the highest (1) ground within `rel_window_m`; `slope` rise over run of the ground smoothed over a cell; `wet` how far the cell lies in a hollow of the ground round it (0 on crests, 1 in the deepest hollows within `wet_window_m`). Each layer paints its `biome` over the biomes `in`, where its noise (cells of `noise_m`) weighs over its threshold.

layers.name: mesa_pocket
layers.comment: green pockets with the damp on the mesas' tops: 10-30% of each top (a connected flat high stretch), drawn by noise weighted towards its hollows

layers.name: canyon_floor
layers.comment: cracked dry crust on the canyons' floors and the approaches: flat low ground, not the wettest hollows (the beds)

layers.name: gravel_field
layers.comment: the stone desert's rubble fields: broad patches over the gentle middle ground
